environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier). PostgreSQL 15 backend accessed through PgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode with prepared_statements=auto. EF Core 7.0 Npgsql provider with connection string pointing to PgBouncer on port 6432. No API gateway or request filtering middleware. Default model binding configuration. No [Bind] attributes or DTO pattern enforced. CORS allows all origins.
